items.text: Solomoni hakupompesha awakulumpi awaIsarela, niejima alemamunyi chidi, niatulamba akumavumu awankakulula jawanyana kaIsarela enzi kuYerusalema kudi mwanta Solomoni, kulonda afumishi chimbaŋu chachitiyaŋenu chaYehova mumukala waDavidi, wowu waZiyona.
Amayala ejima akuIsarela apompeli kudi mwanta Solomoni hachawija, hakakweji kaEtanimi, kokakweji kamuchitanu nachiyedi.
Akulumpi a waIsarela ejima enjili, atupristu hiyakunyamuna chimbaŋu.
Hiyakuleta chimbapu chaYehova, niitenti dakubulakena, niyuma yamwitenti yajilayejima; yumiyi atupristu nawaLevi hiyakuyileta.
Mwanta Solomoni nachipompelu chawaIsarela chejima chapompelikudi yena, adiŋi nindi kumesu achimbaŋu nakuketula nyikoku naŋombi asweja kuvula, kutwesha kuyichinda hela kuyiluka nehi.
Atupristu hiya kwipŋi chimbaŋu chachitiyaŋenu chaYehova mwachu, mwomuwuhoshelu wamwitala, mwomwamweni mwajila, mwomwishina dampuula ja wakerubi.
Muloŋa kerubi atanjikili mpuula jawu hekala chimbaŋu, akerubi hiyakujika hewulu dachimbaŋu nihanyikambu yachu.
Nyikambu hiya kuyi kokamu, kulonda insa janyikambu jimwekanaŋa kwajila kumbidiya kuwuhoshelu; ilaŋa hanzi kumwekanaŋi nehi. Kwoku yidi nikulelu.
Muchimbapu himwadiŋi chumaku, chiŋa wowu malola awubasa ayedi ashilewumu kudi Mosi kuHorebi, hatiyaŋeniyi Yehova chitiyaŋenu nawanyana kaIsarela, hafuminuwu mwituŋa daEjipitu.
Cheliluwu atupristu anafumi dehi mwajila, ivu hidikwinzala mwitala daYehova,
niatupristukutwesha kwimana nakukalakala nehi muloŋa wevu; muloŋa kulema kwaYehova kwenzeli mwitala daYehova.
Solomoni hakuhosha nindi, Yehova nahoshi dehi nindi, Nukushakam amumwidima washishita.
Chalala nakutuŋili itala dakushakama, mweyi mwakushakama haya nyaka.
Mwanta hakushetumuna mesu indi, hakukiswila chipompelu chawaIsarela chejima nkisu. Chipompelu chawaIsarela chejima hichikwimana.
Nindi, Kisu kisu, Yehova Nzambi yaIsarela, wahosheli natata yami Davidi nakanwa kindi, nakoŋumu nawa nachikasa chindi,

mweliliyi nindi, Kufumisha hefuku dinafumishili antu ami aIsarela muEjipitu, munyichidi yawaIsarela yejima hinatondelumu mukala wakutuŋila italadakwikala ijina damuku. Ilaŋa natondeli Davidi kwikala mwanta wawantu ami aIsarela.
Kumuchima watata yami Davidi kwadiŋi jakutuŋila ijina daYehova Nzambi yawaIsarela itala.
Ilaŋa Yehova wamwilili tatayami Davidi nindi, Kumuchima weyi chikwadiŋi jakutuŋila ijina dami italachachiwahi, chawaha chiwachifuukula kumuchima weyi.
Hela chochu, hiyeyi wakatuŋi italaku, mwaneyi wakafuma munkuma yeyi diyi wakatupila ijina dami itala.

Yehova nakoleshi dehi izu dindi dahosheliyi, nanichichinahiŋi dehi mwadiŋi tata yami Davidi, chinashakami dehi hetandada waIsarela dawanta, mwomwakaniniyi Yehova, ami natuŋili dehi ijina daYehova Nzambi yaIsarela itala.
Neli dehi nimwakusha chimbaŋu chikweti chitiyaŋenu chaYehova chatiyaŋeniyi nawankakulula jetu, hayifumishiliyi mwituŋa daEjipitu.
Solomoni hakwimana kumbidi yakameŋi kaYehova kumesu achipompelu cha waIsarela chejima, hakwolola makasindi kwiwulu,

hakwila nindi, Eyi Yehova, Nzambi yaIsarela, hikudi Nzambi wakufwana eyuku, hela mumawulu adi mwiwulu, hela hamaseki adi munu mwishina; wahembaŋa nimuwatiyaŋana nimuwayitiyilaŋa luwi ambuŋeyi endaŋa kumesueyi nanyichima yawu yejima.
Wunahembi nimuwakarini kambuŋeyitata yami Davidi; mwalala wahosheli nakanwa keyi, wunakoŋumu nachikasa cheyi, mwonamutunamoni lelu.

Dichi dinu, eyi Yehova Nzambi yaIsarela, kakelaku muwamukanini kambuŋeyi tata yami Davidi, neyi, Eyi hiwakabulahu iyala kumesu ami wakushakama hetanda dawaIsarela dawantaku; chiŋa dinu anyaneyi akababalaŋa mwakuyawu nakwenda kumesu ami neyi chiwunendeyi kumesuami.
Dichi dinu, eyi Nzambi yaIsarela, izu deyi diwahosheli nakambuŋeyitata yami Davidi diikali dalala mwani.
Mwalala kwaamu, Nzambi ashakami heseki? Tala, chikaŋa iwulu, niiwulu damawulu kukuwanineyi nehi, winzi wumoni italidi dinakutuŋili?
Hela chochu, shaku muchima kukulomba kwamami kambuŋeyi, nikukulembelelakwami, eyi Yehova Nzambi yami, wutiyilili nikudila nikulomba kunukulomba ami kambuŋeyi kumesu eyi lelu;
kulonda mesu eyi atoneni italidi niwufuku nimwaana, wutoneni chipela chiwelili neyi, Kwoku kwakekalaŋ ina dami; kulonda wakatiyilili kulomba kwakalombaŋayi kambuŋeyi nakutalisha kuchipelichi.
Wakatiyililaŋa nimwakale mbelelaŋayi kambuŋeyi nimwakalembelela ŋawu antu eyi aIsarela, chakalombaŋawu nakutalisha kuchipelichi. Mwalala wakatiyaŋi mwiwulu muwashakama, chiwakatiyaŋa wakayanakenaŋa.
Neyi muntu wakavulumuna mukwawu, neyi akamukakeja nawu, Sanyikaku, sanyikaku; yena hakenza nakusanyikila kukameŋa keyi mwitalidi;
wakatiyaŋi mwiwulu, wakakwataŋaku, wakasompeshaŋa ambuŋeyi, wakahishaŋa watama nakumushikŋila hanamutu windi mwaneliyi; wakayiŋishaŋa waloŋa nakumwinka yineseki nakuloŋa kwindi.
Neyi antu eyi aIsarela akayitapa kudi ayilumbu jawu nanochu chanakuvulumunuwu dehi, neyi akabalumuka cheŋi kudeyi nakwitu ijina deyi, nakulombela, nakukulembelela mwitalidi;
wakatiyaŋa mwiwulu, wakaanakenaŋa antu eyi aIsarela nshidi yawu, wakayifuntishaŋi cheŋi mwituŋa diwenkeli ankakulula jawu.
Neyi mwiwulu mwakajika, nvula nehi, nanochu chanakuvulumunuwu; chiwakayi babesha, neyi akalomba nakutalisha kuchipelichi, nakwitu ijina deyi, nakubalumuka nakuleka nshidi yawu;
wakatiyaŋi mwiwulu, waka anakenaŋi ambuŋeyi nshidi yawu niantu eyi aIsarela, chiwakayi lejanjila yayiwahi yakwenda; wakayitemeshela nvula hetuŋi deyi diwenkeliantu eyi kudiswana.

Neyi mwituŋa mwakaholoka nzala, hela neyi mwakaholoka chipupu, hela neyi mwakenza kuuma kwakuuma yuma yejima chau, hela mbuwa, hela tubola, hela mahashi; hela neyi chilumbu chawu wakayikuchika munyikala yawu mwituŋa; chipupu chonsu chakamonawu, hela yikatuyonsu yakamonawu;
mwonsu mwakalomba, mwonsu mwakalembelelamuntu himuntu mwahitila antu eyi aIsarela ejima, mwakelukilawu yipupuya munyichima yawu wejima wawu, hiyakolola makasawu nakutalisha kwitalidi;

wakatiyaŋ mwiwulu muwashakama, wakayanakenaŋa, wakakwataŋaku, wakayilaŋa antu ejima, iwu mwaneliyi, iwu mwaneliyi, yeyi welukanyichima yawu—muloŋa eyi, yeyi hohu, weluka nyichima yawanyana kawantu ejima—
kulonda akakutiyaŋa woma mafuku ejima akasha kamawu mwituŋa diwenkeli ankakulula jetu.
Hela mwenyi wákubula kwikala muntu weyi kaIsarela, neyi wakafumakwituŋa dakwakulehi nansaŋu yejina deyi;
muloŋa wena akatiya ijina deyi deneni, nichikasa cheyi chaŋovu, chakwolola; chakenzayi nakulomba nakutalisha kwitalidi;

eyi omu mwiwulu muwashakama wakatiyaŋa, wakelaŋa yejima yakakutambikilayi mwenyi; kulonda nyuza yahamaseki yejima yakeluki ijina deyi, akakutiyi woma, neyi chatiyaŋawu antu eyi aIsarela, kulonda akeluki nawu, italidi dinatuŋi anaditeneni ijina deyi.
Neyi antu eyi akaya nakudasa njita nawayilumbu jawu, njila yonsuyiwakayituma yoyu, neyi akalomba kudi Yehova nakutalisha kumukalawunatondi, kwitala dinaturiili ijina deyi,
wakatiyaŋa mwiwulu nimwanalombuwu, nimwanalembeleluwu, wakayikwashaŋaku nansaŋu yawu.
Neyi akakuvulumuna, —ochu kudi muntu wabulaŋa kuvulumuna? —nineyi hiwakazuwa nawu, hiwakayihana kudi ayilumbu jawu, hiyakayitwalamunyonji mwituŋa dawayilumbu jawu, hela kwakulehi hela kwakwihi;
mwituŋa dakayitwalawu muwukoli neyi akaanakana nakufutumuka cheŋi, hiyakakulembelela omu mwituŋa dayitweluwu muwukoli, nawu, Tunavulumuni dehi, tunatamishi dehi, tunakoŋi chatama;

neyi akafunta kudeyina nyichima yawu yejima, nawumi wawu wejima, omu mwituŋa dawayilumbu jawu ayitweli munyonji, neyi akalomba kudeyi nakutalisha kwituŋa dawudiwenkeli ankakulula jawu, kumukala wunatondi, kwitala dinatuŋili ijina deyi;
eyi omu mwiwulu muwashakama wakatiyaŋa nimwakalombawunimwakalembelelawu, wakayikwashaŋaku nansaŋu yawu,
wakayanakenaŋa antu eyi anakuvulumuni, ninyiloŋa yawu yaneluwu yakumotoka izudeyi, wakayitiyishaŋa wushona awa ayitweli munyonji, kulonda akayitiyilaŋa wushona.
Muloŋa wena hiyantu eyi, hiwuswana weyi wafumishili muEjipitu mukachi kalutepi lwachikuŋu.
Mesu eyi akatoneni kulembelelakunu kulembelela ami kambuŋeyi, nikwakalembelelawu antu eyi aIsarela, wakayitiyililaŋa mwakakudililawu mwejima.
Muloŋa wayambwili dehi mukachi kanyuza yejima yahamaseki, kulonda akekali wuswanaweyi, mwomuwahosheli kukanwa kakambuŋeyi Mosi, hiwafumishili ankakululajetu muEjipitu, eyi Mwanta Yehova.
Chelili Solomoni nakumishi dehi kulomba kwejimiku nikumulembelela Yehova, hakunyamuka kumesu akameŋa kaYehova kwadiro kwafukamayi hamanuŋu indi, iku wolola makasindi kwiwulu.
Hakwimana, hakukiswila chipompelu chawaIsarela chejima nkisu nezu daŊovu,
nindi, Kisu kisu, Yehova nanookeshi dehi antu indi aIsarela mwakaniniyi mwejima. Chikaninu chindi chachiwahi chejima chakaniniyi kukanwa kakambu ŋindi Mosi hikunakaŋanyi hoku izu nidimuku.
Yehova Nzambi yetu ekalinanetu neyi chadiŋiyi nawankakulula jetu; bayi akatushiya hela kutúumbaku;
atepeleki nyichima yetu kudi yena, twendi munjila jindi jejima, tuhembi nimwaleja ŋayi, niyidika yindi, niwuŋaji windi walejeliyi ankakulula jetu.

Awa mazu ami inukulembelela kumesu aYehova, ekali kwakwihi naYehova Nzambi yetu nimwaana niwufuku, kulonda akakwashaŋaku ami kambuŋindi nansaŋu yami, akakwashaŋaku niantu indi aIsarela nansaŋu jawu, ninsaŋuyefuku idi, ninsaŋu yefuku idi.
Kulonda nyuza yejima yahamaseki yakeluki nawu, Yehova diyi Nzambi, hikudi wacheŋuku.
Kulonda nyichima yenu yakayaŋa chikupu kudi Yehova Nzambi yetu, mwakendaŋi muyidika yindi, mwakahembaŋi mwalejaŋayi, neyi chimukwila lelu.
Mwanta niaIsarela ejima hamu hiyakumuketwila Yehova yimuna.

Solomoni hakulambula Yehova yimuna yakuwunda, yamuketwililiyi, aŋombi makombakaji makumi ayedi namakombakaji ayedi, nyikoku makombakaji nkulakaji namakombakaji makumi ayedi. Dimu mwajilikililuwu itala daYehova kudi mwanta nawanyana kaIsarela ejima.

Dena ifuku odumwanta hakujilika hakachi kebulu dadiŋi kumesu etala daYehova; muloŋa adiku kwalambwililiyi himulambu wakushita, nihimulambu wawupa, nimanjia nyilambu yakuwunda; muloŋa kameŋa kawuneŋu kadiŋi kumesu aYehova kakeheli, kutwesha kuwanina nihimulambu wakushita, nihimulambu wawuŋa, nimanji anyilambu yakuwunda nehi.

Henohu Solomoni watelekesheli chawija hamu nawaIsarela ejima; kwadiŋi chipompelu cheneni chawantu akufuma kuwiŋililu wakuHamati ndonikukaloŋa kaEjipitu, kumesu aYehova Nzambi yetu, mafuku atanu nayedi, mafuku atanu nayedi; mafuku ikumi nawana.

Ifuku damu chitanuna chisatu hakuyimwapa antu. Hiyakumukiswila mwanta nkisu, hiyakuyakunyikala yawu nakuzaŋiala, nakutiya kuwaha munyichima yawu, nakuwa hakwejima kwanamwiluwu kambuŋindi Davidi, niantu indi aIsarela kudi Yehova.
